eday.note: Election Day turnout, Nov 3 2026. Kept hourly on Election Day by a scheduled task. 'gap' is Democrats minus Republicans as a percent of all ballots cast that day (negative = Republican). Baselines: the same snapshot time in an earlier year where a source gives it (same_time), otherwise that year's full Election Day. Party registration is not a vote: a Republican-registered voter can vote for a Democrat, and the morning electorate skews older. In the live odds this is weak evidence (see pipeline/live_sim.js) and steps aside once a state's count arrives.

eday.watch_note: Counties to watch, from @earlyvotedata's election-night guides. Each value is [Republican %, Democratic %] of all votes in that county. In the live odds, a state's finished watch counties (80%+ in) give an average swing against 2024 president, added to the 2024 statewide result.
